notes.html:
Does everyone else also treat their life like an optimization problem? Or are some of us just wired like this (not sure if it's a good thing lol).

If the only constant is the passage of time, shouldn't everything we do be centered around it?

notes.title: Welcome to Notes
notes.summary: Notes is where ideas can stay unfinished, opinionated, and alive instead of pretending to be polished blog posts.
notes.html:
I wanted a place on this site that felt more like a working notebook than a polished publication.

Some thoughts will stay short. Some will become essays. Some will start in tech and end up somewhere closer to life, philosophy, or politics.

The point is not to force every idea into a clean thesis. The point is to have a place where I can think in public without flattening everything into "content."
